release: UltraScalp 250 universe + estimator + settings + database load hardening
key_fixes: Settings persistence uses atomic upsert and verifies universe_limit round-trip.
Legacy 40-stock request/worker fallback removed; new default is 250.
Unsaved Scalper UI controls are protected from 3-second status polling overwrites.
Save settings preserves the enabled state; Save & Arm explicitly enables capture.
Estimator resolves requested LargeMidcap-250 selection count before estimating rows.
Estimator/session list no longer execute full-table COUNT scans over scalper snapshots/trades.
Storage relation stats use session snapshot ledger totals plus pg_total_relation_size with a short cache.
Observed effective polling cycle now includes request/processing time plus configured wait.
runtime_limitations: Full Flask production boot was not executed in this container because Flask/psycopg2 are not installed.
Live INDstocks calls require the deployment credentials and were not executed from the build environment.
